description: Executable fixtures for the everyday API (docs/everyday-api.md). Every library must produce exactly these outcomes. Expected values were computed with Python's datetime and zoneinfo (IANA tzdb), independently of the UTV libraries.
comparison: Results are compared as JSON values (object key order is irrelevant). `result` is the single candidate for `unique`; `results` lists all candidates in ascending order for `multiple`. Other statuses have no candidates.
